name: IP & Asset {OS}
tagline: Intellectual property and durable assets: create, protect, license.

commands.name: /ip register
commands.does: Add or update one asset in the register, attach its holder, run the title check.
commands.returns: The asset row with its title status and the next named gap.

commands.name: /ip inventory
commands.does: Sweep every asset category for assets that are not in the register yet.
commands.returns: Assets found, assets added, and what could not be resolved without the user.

commands.name: /ip title
commands.does: Establish chain of title for an asset and name the document that proves it.
commands.returns: Title status proven, unproven or disputed, with the proving or missing document.

commands.name: /ip protect
commands.does: Decide protection posture per jurisdiction: register, hold as trade secret, or accept unregistered.
commands.returns: The decision with its reason, and where registration is chosen, the counsel brief to instruct.

commands.name: /ip license
commands.does: Record a grant out or in with exclusivity, territory, term, field of use and revocation trigger.
commands.returns: The licence record, its executed or unexecuted status, and any exclusivity conflict found.

commands.name: /ip calendar
commands.does: Maintain the renewal and deadline calendar and push dated obligations to Execution {OS}.
commands.returns: Dated obligations with lead times and named human owners, unknown dates surfaced first.

commands.name: /ip watch
commands.does: Triage a suspected infringement against the register.
commands.returns: A classification of ignore, monitor or escalate to counsel, with the evidence attached.

commands.name: /ip value
commands.does: Record a valuation estimate with its method, inputs and date.
commands.returns: The valuation record, labelled an estimate and never an appraisal.

commands.name: /ip schedule
commands.does: Render the register in diligence shape, unproven assets included.
commands.returns: The IP schedule with title status, protection posture, encumbrances and licences out.

commands.name: /ip brief
commands.does: Assemble the counsel brief a professional is instructed from.
commands.returns: The brief, plus a request for approval before anyone is instructed.

requires_human_approval_for: instructing a lawyer, trademark attorney, patent attorney or tax professional, because it opens a matter and a cost
filing or submitting anything to a registry: application, renewal, assignment recordal, opposition, office action response
signing or executing any assignment, licence, NDA, settlement or demand letter
paying or receiving any amount: filing fees, renewal fees, attorney invoices, royalties
recording a licence grant, an assignment, or a change of holder of record
sending anything to a third party, including a licence offer, a demand letter or a trade secret disclosure
marking an asset title status as proven
publishing an IP schedule or valuation outside the user's own systems
